subject: Request: Exec sanction for Hosted API >20% discount — Helio Health
messages:
From: Avery Smith <avery@heliohealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing flexibility request + trial

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Helio is excited by the latency and cost numbers you showed. We ran this past Procurement and finance; there is strong interest but the board is asking for a deeper short‑term concession to make the POC economics work.

High level ask:
- 12 month commitment for usage (expected $1.1M ARR if we land)
- We need a 30% effective discount on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months to get the CFO comfortable

We can move fast on legal and do an accelerated signature if pricing is aligned. I attached a short requirements doc and the internal budget note. Can Redwood stretch on this?

Attachments: Helio_requirements.pdf (summary), Helio_budget_note.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Avery
Avery Smith
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helio Health
avery@heliohealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing flexibility request + trial

Looping you in — Helio is asking for a 30% concession for a $1.0–1.2M first‑year commitment. They are strategic in the payer/tech integrator space and will be a strong reference in the northeast.

Quick notes: 
- They want the discount to apply to hosted token usage (generation + embeddings) for first 12 months.
- Legal has signaled they can turn around contract quickly if commercial is agreed.
- Procurement flagged that if we land this, they will expand to Dedicated in year 2.

Ben / Soojin — recommended play: offer 22% off hosted usage with the following constraints:
  • 12 month minimum committed spend >= $1.0M (billing cadence: monthly)
  • Prepayment for Q1 (or a refundable onboarding credit) to reduce churn risk
  • 60 day SLA inclusion and production remediation support for rollout

If we need >25% we should get Rishi sign‑off. Can you take this to execs now?

—Marissa

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec sign‑off request: Helio Health — hosted usage concession >20%

Rishi — quick summary and ask.

What: Helio Health (prospect) is asking for a 30% off their Hosted API token billing for the first 12 months to make the POC viable. They are offering a 12‑month commitment (expected billings $1.0–1.2M).

Why this matters: Helio is a high‑visibility payer/tech integrator in the northeast and would be a strategic reference for our healthcare vertical. They also indicated a potential move to Dedicated in Y2 which would increase total lifetime value.

Commercial recommendation (from deal team): Approve a 22% discount on Hosted API usage for first 12 months subject to the following conditions:
  • Signed 12‑month commitment with minimum $1.0M booked ARR (monthly invoicing; early termination penalty to cover discounted delta)
  • Upfront payment for Q1 invoices (or escrowed onboarding credit) to reduce churn risk
  • Legal to insert a rollback clause: discount applies only to usage below the committed quantity; overage at list rates
  • Product to include a one‑time onboarding support package (2 on‑site/remote integrations days) and a 60‑day targeted SLA for rollout

Why not full 30%: 30% materially impacts unit economics for Hosted API volume at our current kernel mix; 22% preserves margin while being competitive.

Ask: Rishi — can you sign approval for a 22% concession on Hosted API for Helio now? If you want to push higher (>=25%) we will need a cross‑functional exec waiver (Fin + Revenue ops).

I attached the current rate proposal (v3) and our draft SOW for reference.

Attachments: Helio_Rate_Proposal_v3.pdf; Helio_SOW_v1.docx

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec sign‑off request: Helio Health — hosted usage concession >20%

Thanks for the clear ask and the economics. I approve a concession at 22% for Hosted API usage for the first 12 months with the following non‑negotiable conditions: 

1) Written 12‑month commitment (deal_id HL-2027-042) with a minimum committed billable amount of $1.0M.
2) Finance to require Q1 prepayment or a secured credit instrument to protect unit economics. Work with Revenue Ops to structure cadence.
3) Legal to add a rollback clause and a 30‑day review where Redwood can revert pricing if usage profile materially deviates from the forecasted kernel mix.
4) Sales to secure an executive intro from Helio that commits to a Y2 evaluation for Dedicated migration (documented in the SOW).

If the customer insists on a deeper concession (25%+), we need a formal exec waiver signed by Finance and the CEO. For now, 22% is approved — proceed with redlined quote and DocuSign.

Please confirm when you’ve issued the revised quote so I can close the approval loop.

—Rishi Malhotra
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Smith <avery@heliohealth.com>, Procurement <procure@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing flexibility request + trial — sanctioned concession

Avery / Helio Procurement — thanks for the patience. We’ve reviewed internally and can offer the following concession with exec sign‑off: 

Commercial summary (final):
- 22% off list Hosted API usage for the first 12 months
- Commitment: 12 months, minimum committed spend $1.0M (deal HL-2027-042)
- Billing cadence: monthly; Q1 payment to be collected upfront (or escrowed onboarding credit)
- Rollback clause: discount applies only up to committed usage; overages billed at list rates; 30‑day review window for pricing adjustments if usage profile deviates from forecast
- Onboarding: 2 integration days of premium support included; 60‑day targeted SLA for rollout issues

I’ve attached the redlined commercial proposal (Helio_Rate_Proposal_v3.pdf) and the draft SOW (Helio_SOW_v1.docx). Please review and return the signed DocuSign link (https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=xyz123) and we’ll prioritize kickoff.

If Finance needs the prepayment routed differently let me know — we can work with Revenue Ops for wire instructions.

Next steps:
1) Review and sign redlined quote in DocuSign.
2) Legal to run through SOW and insert the Dedicated evaluation clause for Y2.
3) Kickoff technical onboarding once Q1 payment is received.

Thanks — excited to partner here.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
